paper.title_en: The generalized i-boson model and the BUC hierarchy
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop the generalized i-boson algebra and its Fock-space representation. By means of the quantum inverse scattering method, the (N, N)-particle states and scalar products of the generalized i-boson model are expressed in terms of the generalized Q-functions, which are (restricted) τ functions of the BUC hierarchy. Furthermore, the shifted topological vertex without boundary conditions is shown to admit a vacuum expectation value representation using vertex operators associated with generalized Q-functions.
